title: 第17章 饺子与召唤媒介第18章 夜晚会议
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
三人围坐在桌边，法伦详细地解释着每一种解法，千代认真地做着笔记，而妮可虽然听不懂数学问题，却也专注地看着法伦的讲解，似乎在努力理解。
时间在不知不觉中流逝，面团也醒得差不多了。
法伦站起身，开始准备包饺子。
他先将面团揉搓成长条，然后切成一个个小剂子，用擀面杖擀成饺子皮。
每一个动作都显得那么熟练和自然，饺子这东西以前法伦在地球上的时候经常做，基本上逢年过节都是吃这玩意儿。
妮可和千代看着法伦手上的动作，都有些惊讶。
妮可忍不住赞叹道：“法伦，没想到你做饭这么厉害，这手艺都可以去开店了！”
千代也点头表示赞同：“是啊，看你做菜的样子，真是让人佩服。”
法伦笑了笑，手上的动作没有停歇：“这算什么，以前在家里的时候，我叔叔当兵的时候落下隐疾，这几年家里的饭菜都是我来做的。
之后有机会让你们尝尝硬菜吧。”
法伦嘴里经常会吐出一些非常奇怪的词语，二人听多了也只当是东南海岸的方言了。
“你们要试试包饺子吗？”
法伦看两个人一直站在旁边看自己，也有点不自在，便开口邀请道。
妮可跃跃欲试，感觉她只要是关于吃的就很来劲，千代也没有拒绝。
法伦教了一下两人怎么包之后，三个人就围着小餐桌开始包饺子。
随着最后一个饺子包好，锅里的水也烧开了。
法伦将饺子下锅，用勺子轻轻搅动，防止饺子粘锅。
不一会儿，饺子就在锅里翻腾起来，散发出诱人的香气。
饺子在热水中翻滚，渐渐变得透明时，妮可和千代都忍不住凑近了观看。
对她们来说，这种食物是完全陌生的，充满了新奇。

妮可好奇地问：“法伦，这个...水饺，是煮熟了就能吃吗？看起来好特别。”
法伦微笑着点头：“对，煮到饺子浮起来，再点一次水，等它们再次浮起来就可以吃了。”
千代则更加细致地观察着饺子在水中的变化，她注意到饺子皮逐渐变得透明，隐约可见内里的馅料：“这样煮，馅料会不会不熟？”
法伦解释说：“不会的，馅料在包的时候就已经是半熟的了，而且牛肉和胡萝卜都比较容易熟，只要饺子皮熟了，里面也就好了。”
随着法伦用漏勺将煮好的饺子捞出，放在盘子里，端到桌上，妮可和千代都迫不及待地拿起筷子。
饺子的香气扑鼻而来，让两人更加期待它的味道。
妮可小心翼翼地夹起一个饺子，轻轻吹了吹，然后小心翼翼地咬了一小口。
饺子皮的柔滑和馅料的鲜美瞬间在她的口腔中爆发，她惊喜地睁大了眼睛：“哇，这味道太棒了！
牛肉和胡萝卜搭配得恰到好处。”
千代也尝了一个，她细细品味着，感受着饺子带来的新奇口感和味道：“这皮很有弹性，跟东流岛的煎饺完全不一样。
馅料也很香，真的很好吃。”
【魅力值+5】
法伦看着两人的表情，心中涌起一股成就感：“喜欢就好，我还担心你们会不习惯这种吃法呢。”
妮可连连摇头：“不会，不会，这比我平时吃的食物要有趣多了。
原来食物还可以这样做，真是太神奇了。”
content_en:
The three of them sat around the table. Fallon explained each solution in detail, Chiyo took notes seriously, and although Nicole couldn't understand the math problems, she watched Fallon's explanation intently, seeming to be trying to understand.
Time passed unconsciously and the dough was almost awake.
Fallon stood up and started making dumplings.
He first kneaded the dough into long strips, then cut it into small pieces and rolled it into dumpling wrappers with a rolling pin.
Every movement seemed so skillful and natural. Fallon used to make dumplings a lot when he was on Earth. He usually ate them during holidays.
Nicole and Chiyo looked a little surprised at the movements of Fallon's hands.
Nicole couldn't help but admire: "Fallon, I didn't expect you to be so good at cooking. You can even open a store with your skills!"
Chiyo also nodded in agreement: "Yes, the way you cook is really impressive."
Fallon smiled and kept moving his hands: "What's this? When I was at home, my uncle fell ill when he was in the army. In the past few years, I have cooked all the meals at home.
I'll let you try the hard food later when I get the chance. "
Fallon often uttered some very strange words in his mouth, and the two of them just thought they were dialects from the southeast coast.
"Do you want to try making dumplings?"
Fallon felt a little uncomfortable seeing the two people standing nearby and looking at him, so he opened his mouth to invite.
Nicole was eager to give it a try, feeling that she was very excited as long as it was about food, and Chiyo did not refuse.
After Fallon taught the two how to make dumplings, the three of them gathered around the small dining table and started making dumplings.
As the last dumpling was wrapped, the water in the pot boiled.
Fallon puts the dumplings into the pan and stirs them gently with a spoon to prevent them from sticking to the pan.
After a while, the dumplings began to stir in the pot, exuding an attractive aroma.
As the dumplings tumbled in the hot water and gradually became transparent, Nicole and Chiyo couldn't help but look closer.
For them, this kind of food is completely unfamiliar and full of novelty.
Nicole asked curiously: "Fallon, can this... dumpling be eaten after being cooked? It looks so special."
Fallon smiled and nodded: "Yes, cook the dumplings until they float, then add water again, and then you can eat them when they float again."
Chiyo observed the changes of the dumplings in the water more carefully. She noticed that the dumpling wrappers gradually became transparent, and the fillings inside were faintly visible: "If you cook it like this, will the fillings be undercooked?"
Fallon explained: "No, the fillings are already half-cooked when they are made, and beef and carrots are easier to cook. As long as the dumpling wrapper is cooked, the inside will be ready as well."
As Fallon took out the cooked dumplings with a slotted spoon, placed them on a plate, and brought them to the table, both Nicole and Chiyo eagerly picked up their chopsticks.
The aroma of dumplings filled their nostrils, making the two of them look forward to its taste even more.
Nicole carefully picked up a dumpling, blew it gently, and then carefully took a small bite.
The smoothness of the dumpling skin and the deliciousness of the fillings instantly exploded in her mouth, and her eyes widened in surprise: "Wow, this tastes great!
The beef and carrots go perfectly together. "
Chiyo also tasted one. She savored it carefully and felt the novel texture and taste brought by the dumplings: "The skin is very elastic, which is completely different from the fried dumplings on Dongliu Island.
The filling is also very fragrant and really delicious. "
[Charm value +5]
Fallon looked at the expressions of the two of them and felt a sense of accomplishment in his heart: "As long as you like it, I'm worried that you won't be used to this way of eating."
Nicole shook her head repeatedly: “No, no, this is much more interesting than the food I usually eat.
It’s amazing that food can still do this. "
